scope: Five SC01 recordings. Only SC01_FIRST_REPORT_001/002 regenerated on2026-10-29 for current glass-strike report; the three original DALE recordings remain byte-identical. Later HorrorStory cues pending.

model.name: k2-fsa/OmniVoice
model.license_reason_from_model_card: Constraints from training data, e.g. Emilia
model.license_statement: Downloaded model card: code Apache-2.0; pre-trained model CC-BY-NC because of training-data constraints.

production_pipeline.reuse: Existing local synthesis, trimming, mastering, resampling and measurement; no new engine or paid service.

request_settings.effect_preset: broadcast (documented VoiceStudio default, same as the Kinski corpus: 80 Hz highpass, compressor, mild shelf EQ, limiter; a studio mastering chain, not a phone/radio channel filter)
request_settings.seed_policy: 42 for every take; a broken take may be regenerated with the next seed, logged in retakes.json

DALE.voice_profile_origin: Original Klaus Kinski argument with Walter Saxer on the Fitzcarraldo set, reproduced in Werner Herzog's documentary Mein liebster Feind (1999). A locally selected 6.25-second excerpt conditions the synthetic parody voice; the original recording is not bundled.
DALE.basis: Tom's explicit instruction: same profile and settings as the existing Kinski corpus (web/production/kinski/provenance.json).

DISPATCH.profile_name: SIGNAL 47 fictional man caller (synthetic CC0 cast)

source_recording.license: CC0-1.0 as explicitly stated for voice-donations in the pinned repository README
source_recording.method: 40ms autocorrelation, RMS gate .015, lag40-230 at16k, normalized correlation >.5. Register estimate only; octave errors possible. Not age/gender verification.
source_recording.conditioning_text: Would like to buy an avocado one that is green on the outside and green.

DISPATCH.basis: Existing anonymous CC0 male caller reference. Distinct from Dale and every named character cast; previous anonymous caller use remains documented in radiocast provenance.

postprocessing.channel_filter: Applied by runtime phone bus, not baked into masters.

cache: ~/.cache/signal47-horror/sc01; raw sources, API responses and finished WAV outside Git.
